project_info.theme: Natural powder-blue bedroom reclining fashion portrait
project_info.color_palette: powder blue, indigo blue, ivory, soft brown, neutral skin tones

main_subject.detail: An adult East Asian woman with a slim, realistically proportioned figure, light neutral skin with natural variation, oval face with mild asymmetry, long natural-black hair half-up in a small bun with a slight wave and visible flyaways, and a soft open direct gaze. She wears a powder-blue opaque structured cropped top with a flattering sweetheart neckline and subtle corset seams, blue designer-inspired monogram denim shorts without readable logo or text, a thin black velvet choker with tiny pendant, stud earrings, simple rings, a white fabric scrunchie, and delicate bracelets.
main_subject.style: photorealistic natural editorial portrait with lifelike texture and minimal tasteful retouching

items: reclining relaxed on back on a plush bed with slightly wrinkled off-white linens and pillows
right arm raised with fingers lightly touching hairline
left arm bent across torso with hand resting at midriff
head slightly tilted toward camera left
upper-right dark round tray with a small white ceramic tea set on textured brown surface
overhead 9:16 view with slight tilt toward face, framed head to upper hips

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large window through sheer curtains or 120cm double-diffused softbox at 5200K, 45 degrees from camera right
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: very soft directional modeling, white bedding bounce about 1.5 stops under key, soft nose and lip shadow, crisp soft eye catchlights, no bloom

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame 85mm lens at f/3.2, ISO 200, 1/200s; near eye focus
technical_specs.color_treatment: true-to-life neutrals with powder and indigo blue accents, medium-low contrast, fine 1.5-2% film grain, visible pores and bedding creases

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 9:16 indoor reclining editorial portrait of an adult East Asian woman with a slim realistically proportioned figure, light neutral skin with natural variation, oval face with mild asymmetry, natural-black half-up hair with a small bun, soft wave, and visible flyaways. She reclines relaxed on a plush bed with wrinkled off-white linens: her right arm is raised with fingers touching her hairline, her left arm crosses her torso with hand at her midriff, and her head tilts slightly toward camera left. She wears a powder-blue opaque structured cropped top with a flattering sweetheart neckline and subtle corset seams, blue designer-inspired monogram denim shorts with no readable logo or text, a black velvet choker, stud earrings, simple rings, a white scrunchie, and delicate bracelets. Place a dark round tray with a small white tea set on textured brown surface at upper right. Use a large sheer-curtain window or double-diffused 120cm softbox at 5200K from camera right with white-bedding bounce. Shoot overhead with a slight faceward tilt on a full-frame 85mm at f/3.2, near-eye focus, natural pores, fine film grain, and true-to-life powder-blue, indigo, ivory, and soft-brown color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, see-through fabrics, wardrobe malfunction, underboob, sideboob, doll, BJD, porcelain skin, neotenous proportions, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, oversized eyes, poreless skin, bloom, CGI, 3D render, illustration, wide-angle distortion, random text, readable logo, watermark, extra fingers, distorted anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, and bedroom references may be attached. Preserve the adult identity, reclined pose, powder-blue structured top, non-branded blue monogram-inspired shorts, bedding, tea tray, and window-light direction; do not reproduce branded logos or readable marks.

changes: Replaced age-bracket wording with explicitly adult.
Removed explicit body-size measurements and body-part emphasis while preserving the fitted powder-blue structured top, reclined pose, silhouette, and window lighting.
Replaced brand-specific shorts and logo requirements with non-branded monogram-inspired denim to avoid trademark replication.
